properties.description: As built 2026-09-19: `summary:` and `audience:` on all 30 skills (mirrored to .claude and .grok); build.rs frontmatter() parses both and panics on a missing field, an unknown audience, or a trigger-shaped/over-long summary; EmbeddedSkill carries them; list_skills adds both per skill and its note counts the shortcuts that differ from the name; get_skill adds both; skill_lint checks both; tests/served_skills.rs pins them. Audience as first assigned: 19 anyone, 10 operator, 1 agent (link-artifacts) — the owner's call to revise per skill.
properties.name: Every served skill carries summary and audience in its frontmatter, build.rs and the lint refuse a skill without them, list_skills and get_skill serve both, and the differing-shortcut count is computed
